title: Tailor's Mannequin
what: An existing voice changed by describing the change: age, accent, energy. The voice stays recognisably Bram's while the description reshapes it.

inputs.label: Line
inputs.value: Forty years I've kept this light, and every night the sea tells me a new story. Tonight it says a storm is coming, so put the kettle on and stay in.

inputs.label: Older
inputs.value: Make him much older, frail and whispery, as if speaking quietly from an armchair by the fire.

inputs.label: Irish
inputs.value: Give him a warm Irish accent and a cheerful, sing-song energy.

inputs.label: Young
inputs.value: Make him a young man in his twenties: the same gravelly tone, but faster and full of energy.

snippet:
d = requests.post(f"https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-voice/{bram}/remix",
    headers={"xi-api-key": KEY},
    json={"voice_description": "Give him a warm Irish accent.", "text": LINE}).json()
audio = base64.b64decode(d["previews"][0]["audio_base_64"])
